material.description: Design, from the user: character icons carry their well-known acronym in capitals behind the icon, and the name under the icon goes. Contract for both lanes: a portraits item gains an optional string field badge. When badge is set, draw it in capitals, large and low-contrast, centred behind the icon (the portrait PNGs are RGBA, so the transparent areas show it; the icon draws on top). When text is empty or absent, draw no label under the icon. Items without badge render exactly as before. Ownership: js/client/widgets.js only. Acceptance: CI static client checks green on the pushed sha. Witness: the lobby screenshot after the panel lane lands.
